title: Aperture
description: One opening a link demands on a building face. The exterior layer must keep this face region clear and carve exactly the cut polygon. Face i of a building is the vertical quad over footprint segment i -> i+1 (footprint counter-clockwise, outward normal to the right of the directed segment). Face-local frame: origin at footprint vertex i at z=0, U along the segment (meters), V straight up (meters).

floor.description: floor the opening belongs to; -1 = basement (tunnels)

u.description: face-local U of the opening center, meters along the segment from vertex i

v.description: face-local V of the opening center, meters above z=0 (world ground)

width.description: opening width along U, meters (bounding size for slanted cuts)

cut.description: Exact closure geometry. polygon is the intersection of the link solid with the face plane, so a diagonal link meeting the face closes with no gap.

polygon.description: world-space [x,y,z] loop, counter-clockwise seen from outside; every vertex lies exactly on the face plane

axisDir.description: unit direction of the link axis at this end, pointing away from the building
